T: Feed me. Then feed everyone else.
D: A nerdy florist raises a talking plant that grows by eating people.
P: Serve the mains when Audrey II says feed me.
S: Radish roses, carrot ribbons, cucumber and baby capsicum arranged in a vase like a bunch of flowers, with a green goddess dip.
Small hard taco shells filled with spiced beef mince, lettuce and cheese, a few strips of red capsicum hanging out like a tongue.
Baby plant sesame chilli sugar snaps
little green pods, like the baby plant

Crisp sugar snap peas flashed in boiling water, tossed with sesame oil, chilli, lime and flaky salt, with a creamy miso mayo for dipping. Bring a pot of salted water to the boil and blanch 400g sugar snap peas for 30 seconds, then plunge into iced water and drain well. Toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds, half a sliced red chilli, a squeeze of lime and flaky salt. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp white miso and 1 tsp lime juice for dipping.
M: Audrey dreams of a tidy suburban life and dinner on a tray

Golden crumbed chicken schnitzel with buttery mashed potato, peas and corn and a little pot of gravy, all served on a sectioned tray like a fifties TV dinner. Flatten 2 large chicken breasts and cut each into 2. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko mixed with parmesan. Shallow fry in 1cm oil for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Cook 300g frozen peas and corn with butter. Make 300ml gravy from a packet mix. Arrange on 4 trays in sections.
the plant wants more, so do you
Beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, then simmered 40 minutes in a tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
W: Buttermilk cupcakes tinted deep green, baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cream cheese frosting with red sugar on top like the plant's lips.
K: for the hungry plant on Skid Row

Lime sorbet floated in a frothy bowl of lemonade, pineapple juice and fresh lime, bright green and fizzing, with mint leaves on top. Pour 500ml cold pineapple juice and the juice of 3 limes into a punch bowl. Add 1.25L cold lemonade slowly so it keeps its fizz. Drop in 8 scoops of lime sorbet so they float and froth up the top. Scatter with torn mint and thin lime slices and ladle into 4 glasses straight away.

s.how: Cut radishes into roses, peel carrots into ribbons and slice a cucumber and baby capsicums. Arrange in a vase like flowers. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, chives and lemon for the dip.
Brown 400g beef mince with taco spices. Fill 12 small taco shells with the mince, shredded iceberg and 100g cheddar. Hang a strip of red capsicum out of each like a tongue.

m.note: the plant wants more, so do you
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 slices soaked bread, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins crushed tomatoes. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tbsp cocoa, 125ml buttermilk and green colouring. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Frost with 200g cream cheese beaten with 200g icing sugar and add a line of red sugar.
